Full Stack Developer

We are a growing technology company seeking a talented Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team. We build SaaS products for the logistics industry.

Responsibilities:
- Develop new features across the full stack
- Maintain and improve React frontend applications
- Build Node.js backend APIs with Express
- Design and optimize PostgreSQL database schemas
- Participate in agile sprint ceremonies

Required skills:
- React and JavaScript/TypeScript
- Node.js with Express or Fastify
- PostgreSQL
- REST API design
- Git

Nice to have:
- Redis
- Docker
- AWS

Competitive compensation and benefits. Hybrid work, 2 days in office per week.

Please apply through our website's careers page.
